items.q: What is a full stack developer course?
items.a: A full stack developer course teaches you to build a complete website or web app: the part users see (the front end), the server behind it (the back end) and the database that stores the data. At eBuddha Digitech you learn HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Node.js and MongoDB (the MERN stack), plus AI tools, through live classes and hands-on projects.

items.q: Is this full stack developer course available online, and where are you based?
items.a: Yes. This is a live online full stack developer course, so you can join from Bhopal, from anywhere in India or from another country. eBuddha Digitech is based in MP Nagar, Bhopal, and has trained learners since 2018. Sessions run in the evening, and mentors help you with your doubts.

items.q: How long is the full stack course?
items.a: It runs for 20 weeks with 144+ hours of live sessions, in five milestones of four weeks each. You move from web basics to JavaScript, React, back-end development and AI engineering, and finish by deploying live projects.
The MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React and Node.js), TypeScript, API integration and cloud deployment, along with AI models such as OpenAI, Claude, Gemini and Groq.

items.q: Does the course include AI tools for development?
items.a: Yes. You learn to use AI coding assistants to write, test and launch code faster, and to build AI features such as a chatbot and a tool that answers questions from your own documents (RAG).

items.q: What makes this full stack course different from others?
items.a: You learn in live classes with working developers, practise every week through hackathons and build sessions, finish 20+ projects and graduate with a portfolio, a certificate and placement support. The course is designed for beginners, so you never need to guess the next step.

items.q: Is this full stack course suitable for beginners?
items.a: Yes. No coding background is needed. You start with how websites work and HTML, then move step by step to JavaScript, React, back-end development and AI. Most weeks end with a small project so you can see your progress.

items.q: Can I join if I am a fresher or from a non-IT background?
items.a: Yes. Freshers, college students, working professionals and career switchers join this course. The first milestone covers the basics, so you do not need a computer science degree or earlier coding experience.

items.q: How much does the full stack course cost?
items.a: The current fee is Rs 22,000 (regular fee Rs 30,000), a flat Rs 8,000 off for a limited time. For payment options and the next batch date, fill in the enquiry form or WhatsApp +91 84619 58162.

items.q: Will I have a portfolio when I finish?
items.a: Yes. You host your best projects online and finish with a portfolio website and a GitHub profile to show recruiters.

items.q: Is there any hands-on practice besides the lessons?
items.a: Yes. The course includes hackathons and build sessions where you ship code alongside mentors, plus 30+ assignments.

items.q: What roles can I apply for after the course?
items.a: Full Stack Developer, Front-End Developer, Back-End Developer and AI-assisted web developer roles, with startups and product companies in Bhopal, other Indian cities and remote teams.
Yes. We provide placement support: resume and GitHub review, mock interviews and sharing your profile with our hiring partners. Hiring decisions stay with the employer.

items.q: What is the average salary of a full stack developer?
items.a: In India the average full stack developer salary is around INR 8.6 lakh per year, and with 3 to 6 years of experience it can go beyond INR 15 lakh. Pay depends on your city, skills and company.

items.q: Can I work remotely or for international companies?
items.a: Yes. Many full stack roles are remote or hybrid. With a strong portfolio, an active GitHub profile and clear communication, you can apply to companies in India and abroad.
